Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1200 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 300 000 TPE/PME et plus de 7000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

---------

Pennylane a une ambition claire : devenir le meilleur OS financier du marché. Et une partie de ce pari repose sur notre capacité à être la plateforme la plus ouverte et la plus connectée de l'écosystème.

En 2025, on a franchi un cap majeur en France : 300+ intégrations, le lancement de notre offre e-invoicing pour les éditeurs de logiciels, et la création d'une business unit dédiée — Connectivity — qui rassemble Engineering, Product et Partnerships sous un même toit.

En 2026, on passe la vitesse supérieure : 500+ apps sur notre marketplace, une équipe qui scale à 40 personnes, des revenus directement trackés par partenaire tech, et un écosystème qui devient un vrai moteur de croissance. On prépare aussi l'expansion internationale et l'ère de la connectivité IA, avec pour horizon €40–50M ARR d'ici 2030.

Pour y arriver, on recrute un(e) Head of Tech Partnerships : la personne qui va prendre la main sur notre stratégie partenaires, structurer l'équipe, lancer notre partner program, et transformer les intégrations en un vrai levier business.

 

Comment tu vas contribuer ?

Tu rejoins la business unit Connectivity, en reporting direct au General Manager Connectivity (Arnaud). Tu prends ownership de toute la fonction Tech Partnerships, avec sept membres d'équipe déjà en place (Partner Managers, Solution Engineers, Team Lead).

Concrètement, tu seras responsable de :

  • Définir et exécuter la stratégie partenaires tech, alignée avec la vision Connectivity et Pennylane

  • Structurer, recruter et faire grandir l'équipe en fonction de la roadmap

  • Construire notre tech partner program (tiering, incentives, certifications, bénéfices associés)

  • Transformer les partenariats tech en moteur de revenus et de génération de leads qualifiés (en lien avec Sales)

  • Positionner Pennylane comme leader dans l'écosystème (événements partenaires, communauté, marketplace)

  • Soutenir l'expansion internationale de notre réseau d'intégrations

 

À quoi ressemblera ton quotidien ?

  1. Piloter la stratégie et le partner program — Définir le tiering, les critères d'éligibilité, les bénéfices et les KPIs de succès (ARR généré, leads qualifiés, clients communs actifs)

  2. Gérer le pipeline partenaires — Qualifier les opportunités, prioriser les partenariats à fort potentiel, animer les relations avec les partenaires stratégiques (flux inbound et outbound)

  3. Driver le partnership revenue — Structurer les accords commerciaux, tracker les pipelines de leads générés par les partenaires, piloter la monétisation des intégrations

  4. Scaler via l'IA et l'automatisation — Réduire le time-to-release, déployer des outils self-onboarding (dev portal, partner portal) et embarquer l'IA dans les process quotidiens (support, documentation, automatisation)

  5. Travailler en mode cross-fonctionnel — Collaborer étroitement avec Product, Marketing et Sales pour maximiser l'impact des intégrations (enablement, GTM, adoption)

  6. Structurer et faire grandir l'équipe — Manager les Partner Managers et Solution Engineers, recruter selon les besoins stratégiques

  7. Owner les KPIs — % de clients équipés, MRR attribué aux partenaires, leads qualifiés générés, taux de certification, usage actif par connecteur

 

Le profil qu'on recherche

Must Have ✅

  • 7+ ans d'expérience en Business Development, Partnerships ou Alliances — idéalement dans une scale-up B2B SaaS

  • Expérience dans les alliances technologiques et intégrations API (pas simplement des partenariats commerciaux) — tu sais ce qu'est un webhook, une API REST, un SDK

  • Track record avéré dans la structuration d'un partner program (tiering, contracts, incentives)

  • Fort business acumen : tu raisonnes en termes de ROI, pipeline et revenus générés

  • Leadership et gestion d'équipe : tu as déjà managé des profils BD/Partnership et sais faire grandir une équipe

  • Excellentes capacités de négociation et de relationship-building avec des interlocuteurs techniques ET business

  • Fluent French + professional English (minimum)

Nice to Have ⭐

  • Connaissance de l'écosystème comptable/financier français (ERP, facturation, paie, etc.)

  • Expérience dans le management d'une marketplace ou app store

  • Expérience du lancement à l'international (Allemagne et/ou Espagne, un plus)

  • Maîtrise d'outils comme Salesforce, Crossbeam, ou équivalent

  • À l'aise avec l'IA générative dans son quotidien pro (Dust, Lemlist, LinkedIn Sales Navigator…)

Culture fit / Soft skills

  • Tu es builder avant tout — tu arrives dans un contexte encore en construction et ça t'excite

  • Tu es à l'aise dans l'ambiguïté et tu sais prioriser sans qu'on te dise quoi faire

  • Tu es data-driven sans être paralysé par le manque de données parfaites

  • Tu as un sens aigu de l'ownership et tu t'engages sur des résultats, pas sur des activités

  • Tu sais influencer sans autorité hiérarchique — la transversalité, c'est ton terrain de jeu

Process de recrutement

  1. 📞 Screen TA avec Alison — 30 min

  2. 🧑‍💼 WHO Interview avec Arnaud (GM Connectivity) — 45 min

  3. 📋 Cas pratique + débrief avec Arnaud & Head of Sales SMEs (Jacob) ou Partners (Brieuc) — 60 min

  4. 🤝 Last Round — Global Head of Sales (Edouard) & Senior Engineering Manager Connectivity (Mathieu) — 60 min

title: Lead PayOps
description:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 1 300,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

Role context

Pennylane operates today tens of thousands of business accounts through a BaaS model. As Financial Services becomes a larger part of Pennylane’s strategy, we are building Pennylane Financial Services and applying for Établissement de paiement and Société de financement licences.

Our ambition is to start onboarding new customers under our own licensed entity by early 2027, before progressively migrating existing customers. To make this possible, we are building the operational foundations of a regulated financial entity across onboarding, transaction monitoring, fraud, risk and payment operations.

As Lead Payment Operations, you will be one of the first operational leaders joining this greenfield setup. Reporting to the General Manager / Head of Operations of Pennylane Financial Services, you will own the operational execution of payment operations across SEPA transfers and direct debits, cards, international transfers, cheques, and cash / collateral management.

Your mission will be to build, structure and scale the payment operations setup needed to support growing volumes, ensure reliable execution, manage incidents, and protect customer experience while embedding the controls expected from a strong first line of defense.

This is a high-autonomy role with direct exposure to a strategic regulatory project, close collaboration with Product, Tech, Compliance, Risk and external payment partners, and the opportunity to shape the payment operating model of a fast-growing fintech serving hundreds of thousands of French SMEs.

Responsibilities

Payment operations & execution

  • Own the end-to-end operational execution of payment operations across:

    • SEPA transfers and direct debits,

    • cards,

    • international transfers,

    • cheques,

    • cash and collateral management.

  • Ensure day-to-day reliability of payment operations, including exception handling, operational follow-up, issue resolution, external requests.

  • Act as the operational point of escalation for payment incidents: triage, coordination, customer impact assessment, mitigation, root cause analysis and durable corrective actions.

  • Maintain strong auditability of operational decisions, reconciliations, exceptions and incidents.

Operating model, controls & scalability

  • Build and continuously improve the payment operations operating model:

    • processes,

    • SLAs,

    • runbooks,

    • documentation,

    • knowledge base,

    • onboarding and training materials.

  • Define clear ownership, escalation paths and rituals for payment operations.

  • Design and embed first-line controls aligned with operational risk, regulatory expectations and customer protection.

  • Implement reconciliation, exception-management and incident-management practices proportionate to the risks of each payment rail.

  • Prepare the function to scale from an initial team of 3 people to around 10 people while maintaining quality, resilience and operational discipline.

Performance management & continuous improvement

  • Define, monitor and report on payment operations KPIs, including:

    • volumes,

    • success rates,

    • exception and error rates,

    • incident frequency and MTTR,

    • backlog,

    • SLA adherence,

    • customer-impact metrics.

  • Use operational data to identify bottlenecks, recurring issues and high-leverage improvement opportunities.

  • Drive continuous improvement cycles to reduce manual work, shorten resolution times and improve reliability.

  • Build the reporting cadence needed to keep internal stakeholders aligned on performance, risks and priorities.

Tooling, automation & Product collaboration

  • Partner closely with Product and Tech teams to shape payment back-office tooling and operational workflows.

  • Translate operational pain points into clear product requirements, acceptance criteria and post-launch monitoring needs.

  • Contribute to operational testing before go-live, beyond technical QA: runbooks, edge cases, incident scenarios, reconciliation and handover processes.

  • Identify and prioritize automation opportunities that improve efficiency, quality and customer experience.

  • Balance automation and manual controls pragmatically during the first scaling phase.

Incident management & customer protection

  • Build a structured incident-management framework for payment operations:

    • severity levels,

    • ownership,

    • communication rhythm,

    • escalation paths,

    • root cause analysis,

    • prevention actions.

  • Coordinate with Customer Support, Product, Tech, Compliance, Risk and external partners during operational incidents.

  • Ensure customer-facing issues such as blocked payments, missing transactions, failed transfers or delayed resolutions are handled with urgency and clarity.

  • Use post-mortems and operational learnings to prevent recurrence and improve customer transparency.

External stakeholder management

  • Build and maintain strong operational relationships with payment processing providers, partner banks and other external stakeholders.

  • Define escalation routines and performance expectations with external partners.

  • Keep providers accountable using facts, metrics and structured follow-up.

  • Ensure third-party dependencies are well understood, monitored and integrated into Pennylane Financial Services’ operating model.

Team build-up & leadership

  • Recruit, onboard, train and manage the payment operations team.

  • Operate as a player/coach: remain hands-on on critical topics while progressively building team capacity and autonomy.

  • Define roles, responsibilities, workload distribution and coverage model.

  • Build a team culture based on ownership, rigor, customer protection, operational excellence and continuous learning.

  • Develop the team’s skills across payment operations, incident management, controls and stakeholder management.

First 6–12 months priorities

  • Map current and target payment operations processes across payment rails and identify operational gaps.

  • Define the target operating model, including rituals, SLAs, controls, escalation paths and reporting.

  • Build the first version of payment operations runbooks, incident procedures and reconciliation framework.

  • Set up operational KPIs and reporting routines.

  • Contribute to the design, testing and launch readiness of payment back-office tooling.

  • Recruit and onboard the first team members while maintaining hands-on ownership of critical operations.

  • Build escalation routines with banks, payment processors and internal stakeholders.

  • Improve customer experience by reducing resolution time, increasing transparency and eliminating recurring operational pain points.

Profile & must-have experience

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in payments operations, financial operations, treasury operations or operational risk in a regulated or high-volume environment.

  • Strong exposure to payment operations across at least part of the scope: SEPA transfers and direct debits, cards, international transfers, cheques, cash management or related payment rails.

  • Proven experience managing operational incidents, including triage, escalation, root cause analysis and prevention.

  • Experience designing scalable operational processes, SLAs, runbooks and controls.

  • Experience working with Product and Tech teams on tooling, workflow improvements or automation.

  • Experience managing or coordinating operational teams, ideally in a player/coach setup.

  • Experience managing external operational stakeholders such as banks, PSPs, payment processors or other financial partners.

  • Bonus: experience in a regulated fintech, payment institution, EMI, bank, BaaS / embedded finance provider, or with a payment-institution licence setup.

Technical & operational skills

  • Strong understanding of payment flows, operational failure modes, exceptions and controls.

  • Good knowledge of first-line-of-defense expectations: operational risk ownership, reconciliations, auditability, exception handling and incident management.

  • Strong process mindset: able to structure workflows, clarify ownership and improve quality at scale.

  • Data-driven approach: comfortable defining KPIs, building operational reporting and using metrics to prioritize improvements.

  • Ability to translate operational pain points into clear Product / Tech requirements.

  • Good judgment in balancing reliability, customer experience, operational efficiency and risk control.

  • Ability to design pragmatic automation and tooling improvements without losing operational control.

Soft skills

  • Rigorous, structured and accountable.

  • Strong ownership mindset and ability to prioritize in an ambiguous, fast-scaling environment.

  • Player/coach leadership: comfortable being hands-on while building a team and operating cadence.

  • Excellent communication under pressure, especially during incidents or partner escalations.

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration with Product, Tech, Compliance, Risk, Customer Support and external partners.

  • Customer-conscious: attentive to payment reliability, resolution time and customer impact.

  • Pragmatic and solution-oriented, able to operate under regulatory constraints without creating unnecessary friction.

  • Strong pedagogy: able to explain operational constraints and trade-offs in simple, actionable terms.

Languages, Presence & Location

  • Languages:

    • Fluent French and English are mandatory.

  • Location:

    • Based in France, with a strong preference for Paris.

    • Regular on-site presence in Paris is expected; partial remote is possible, but this is not a fully remote role.

Why Join Us?

  • Greenfield regulatory project: help build the payment operations foundations of a new regulated financial entity from scratch.

  • Massive impact: shape how financial services are delivered to hundreds of thousands of French SMEs.

  • High autonomy: own a critical operational domain with direct impact on reliability, customer experience and go-live readiness.

  • Strategic exposure: work closely with Operations, Product, Tech, Compliance, Risk and external payment partners on a company-defining project.

  • Modern fintech environment: help design scalable, automated and risk-conscious payment operations from day one.

  • Competitive compensation package, including equity components aligned with impact and responsibility.

Hiring process

  • HR interview with Lucie (Senior Recruiter)

  • Who interview Stanislas de Villoutreys (Head of Legal, Compliance and Risk) and Maxime Leclercq (General Manager Financial Services)

  • Case Stanislas and Eric Scaramozzino (VP Strategic Initiatives)

  • Team Fit with Tiffany Dubois (Strategic Project Manager) and Hippolyte Prost (Associate Team Lead Strategy & Operations)

  • Last round with Felix Blossier (COO and cofounder) and Guillaume Nicolle (Lead Internal Control & Risk)

What do we do to make your work life easier

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

Who are we looking for ?

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :

-To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to)

-To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment

-To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)

-Sufficiently experienced to prioritize business-led actions on your day to day activity

We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

Applications through official channels only : apply exclusively through our job postings published on our official platforms (career site, official partner pages).

(bank details, payment for an interview, equipment purchases, etc.) as part of the recruitment process. If such a request is made to you, it is fraudulent. We invite you to not respond and to report it to us immediately.

The Company: Why mute-labs?


mute-labs is the EU market leader in acoustic phone booths, with more than 20,000 cabins sold and counting. We have built a strong direct and dealer business on the back of inbound demand and word of mouth. That gap is this role, and how far into that world you grow is largely up to you.


Outbound is not a new idea for us. We have piloted it in smaller pockets already, testing signal-based outreach and structured sequences with real results. What has been missing is someone to own this as a dedicated motion for bigger accounts rather than a side project squeezed in between other things. That is why we are building this out as a new department and you’d be joining a small, yet focussed team as one of the first hires.

This is a founding position. You are not stepping into an existing sales org with a quota handed down from three reps before you. You are the first one in the building. What you build, and how you build it, is largely up to you and your team, and you can grow the size and ambition of your target accounts as you find your footing.

  • Sales Experience: You have carried a full sales cycle before, from first contact to signed contract, and know how to keep a deal moving without needing someone else to close it for you. You do not need to have sold into large enterprises already, that is something you will grow into here.

We keep this fast and honest, on both sides.

title: Influencer Marketing & Creator Manager (all genders), 100 % Remote
description:
Wann hast du zuletzt aus einem YouTube-Kanal einen SPIEGEL-Bestseller gemacht?

Bei uns ist das der Job. BrainBook macht Bücher mit einigen der größten Gaming-YouTuber Deutschlands, zum Beispiel LukasBS und EinfachGustaf: Romane, Comic-Romane, Reihen, Schwerpunkt Leser zwischen 8 und 14. Sechs Jahre alt, komplett remote, kein Gremium, kein Warten. Wir wirbeln eine Branche auf, die sich seit dreißig Jahren kaum bewegt hat, und nächstes Jahr bringen wir 16 Titel raus.

Dafür suchen wir die Person, die unsere Creator durch ihr Buchprojekt führt: vom ersten Konzept über den Launch bis zu dem Moment, in dem die Community das Buch in den Händen hält. Du kennst die Kanäle, du sprichst die Kampagne mit Creator und Management ab, du sorgst dafür, dass Marketingmaterial, Bonusmaterial und Integrationen rechtzeitig stehen, und du entwickelst mit unserer Programmleitung die nächsten Projekte. Organisiert genug, dass Deadlines halten. Nah genug an der Szene, dass Creator dir vertrauen.

Wenn du in deiner Agentur oder deinem Team die Person bist, die Creator anrufen, wenn es wichtig wird: Wir sollten reden.

Aufgaben

  • Du betreust unsere Creator und ihre Managements: Du kennst ihre Kanäle und ihre Community, bist die erste Ansprechperson für alles rund um Launch und Marketing und hältst den Kontakt vom ersten Konzept bis zu dem Tag, an dem das Buch erscheint, und darüber hinaus.
  • Du sprichst die Kampagne mit Creator und Management ab: Marketing-Calls, Integrationsplan mit Long-Form- und Short-Form-Formaten, Ankündigungs- und Launch-Termine. Du hältst den Plan in ClickUp nach, fasst nach, wenn etwas fehlt, und trägst die Ergebnisse je Integration in unseren Report ein.
  • Du bereitest jeden Launch nach unserer Checkliste vor: Timeline von der Ankündigung bis zum Erscheinungstermin, Vorbestellung, Gewinnspiele, Aktionen im Shop, auf Amazon und im TikTok Shop, abgestimmt mit Lektorat, Produktion und Design. Jedes Buch hat ein festes Launch-Budget, innerhalb dessen du Material und Freelancer selbst beauftragst. Jeden Freitag fasst du den Stand aller laufenden Launches in einem kurzen Report zusammen.
  • Du organisierst das Marketingmaterial mit dem Creator und unserem Design-Team: Teaser- und Shorts-Konzepte, Produktbilder, Creator-Boxen, Autogrammkarten, Dummy-Drucke und Bonusmaterial wie Poster, Maps oder Texture Packs. Du briefst Design-Team und externe Kreative, steuerst Revisionen und holst die Freigabe des Creators ein. Gestaltet wird im Design-Team, du hältst die Fäden.
  • Du bereitest mit unserer Programmleitung Pitches für neue Creator vor: Kanalanalyse, Konzeptskizze, Präsentation. Erstgespräche und Verhandlungen führt unser Geschäftsführer, du bist dabei, auch auf Messen und Events, und übernimmst mit der Zeit mehr.

Qualifikation

  • Mindestens ein Jahr Erfahrung im Influencer Marketing, im Creator- oder Talent-Management oder im Kampagnen- und Projektmanagement, zum Beispiel als Junior in einer Agentur, auf Markenseite oder in einem Creator-Management. Mehr ist willkommen, Voraussetzung ist es nicht.
  • Du hast schon mit Creatorn oder ihren Managements gearbeitet: Briefings, Freigaben, Termine, Nachfassen. Du bleibst dabei freundlich und verbindlich, schriftlich wie im Call.
  • Du kennst Long-Form und Short-Form aus der Praxis, kannst einen Kanal einschätzen (Zielgruppe, Formate, Reichweite, Qualität der Integrationen) und weißt, was Views, Watchtime, Klicks und Conversion über eine Integration aussagen.
  • Du hast schon mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig mit festen Deadlines organisiert, arbeitest im Home-Office selbstorganisiert und findest dich schnell in Projektmanagement-Systemen ein.
  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau, Englisch in Wort und Schrift.
  • Ein Plus, kein Muss: eigene Kontakte zu Creatorn, Managements oder Agenturen, Gaming- oder Kids-Content-Affinität, Erfahrung mit den Kennzeichnungsregeln für Creator-Content.

Kein Ausschluss: Du musst nicht alles schon gemacht haben. Bücher, Buchhandel und Verlagsprozesse bringen wir dir bei. Was du mitbringst, ist das Gespür für Creator und ihre Communities und die Organisation, damit aus einer Idee ein Launch wird.

Benefits

  • Einstieg 36.000 bis 40.000 € im Jahr, je nach Erfahrung, plus Prämien ohne Deckel: für jeden komplett vorbereiteten Launch, für jede Kampagne, in der die vereinbarten Integrationen live gehen, und für jeden SPIEGEL-Bestseller zahlen wir extra, realistisch 4.000 bis 5.000 € im Jahr. Wer liefert, verdient hier mehr, und zwar automatisch, nicht nach Verhandlung.
  • Vollzeit, unbefristet, 100 % Home-Office, Firmensitz in Kiedrich.
  • 40 Stunden mit Arbeitszeitkonto: Plusstunden verfallen nicht, ab 37 Plusstunden zahlen wir automatisch aus.

title: Interim project - Senior DevOps Consultant (f/m/d)
description:
Job description

We are seeking an experienced Senior DevOps Consultant to support a defined project at our Headquarters in Berlin.

The assignment is focused on the set-up and further development of our data management and infrastructure platform. The initial consulting engagement is planned for six months, with the possibility of extending the assignment for a further period, potentially up to 12 months in total, subject to project requirements and mutual agreement. The consultant will provide specialist DevOps and data-platform expertise within the scope of the project. The assignment is structured as an independent consulting engagement, with responsibility for delivering agreed project outcomes and technical solutions.

The project supports our Climate Policy Team, which is engaged in various projects on climate change mitigation, in particular on energy system transformation, evaluation of emissions scenarios, the 1.5°C global warming limit and evaluation of national climate action. This includes flagship projects such as the Climate Action Tracker and the National Pathways Explorer, for which data is processed and analysed in-house and then published on the respective project websites.

As part of the assignment, the consultant will work on the shared data platform and infrastructure used across the organisation. Our platform is self-hosted on our own hardware and currently runs PostgreSQL, MinIO, GitLab CI/CD and containerised workloads on Linux. The consultant is expected to organise and perform the assignment independently, within the agreed project scope and in coordination with relevant project stakeholders.
Your responsibilities

  • Build and operate the data platform for advanced analytics and climate modelling, spanning DevOps and data engineering work.
  • Take the platform from single-server deployments to properly separated environments, with orchestration and infrastructure as code.
  • Establish and improve the platform's operational practices, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, capacity planning and performance optimisation.
  • Design and implement the access, identity and secrets model across platform and shared infrastructure.
  • Contribute to the standardisation of production data workflows and platform standards across the organisation.
  • Document what you build (runbooks, architecture notes and handover material) to ensure continuity.
  • Provide technical guidance to data analysts and scientists and support the adoption of good practice in DataOps, security and governance.
  • Evaluate new tools and technologies, run proof-of-concepts, and help define the technical roadmap for our infrastructure.


Your profile

Relevant Tech Skills
Required:

  • Python and shell scripting.
  • Linux servers in production.
  • Container orchestration you have operated yourself, including cluster setup and upgrades (Kubernetes, Docker).
  • Infrastructure as Code and configuration management (Ansible, or equivalent).
  • Operational experience with PostgreSQL (backup and point-in-time recovery, tested restores, version upgrades and connection pooling).
  • Monitoring tools (like Prometheus, Grafana) and alert design.
  • A solid understanding of distributed systems in an on-premise context.
Nice to have:
  • S3-compatible object storage operations (MinIO, Ceph).
  • Identity and directory services like LDAP, Keycloak, or SSO integration across self-hosted tools.
  • Virtualisation platforms (Proxmox, KVM).
  • Have actively applied data governance principles to manage data quality, security, and compliance, and understand how to implement controls that protect sensitive information.
  • Some experience deploying AI projects.
Qualifications
You will ideally have the following qualifications and skills:
  • You have more than 5 years of experience operating Linux servers in production, including on-premise or bare-metal environments (not exclusively managed cloud).
  • Proven ability to build automated pipelines that streamline development, testing and deployment for data-related projects.
  • You are an excellent troubleshooter who excels at diagnosing and fixing data infrastructure and identifying performance bottlenecks.
  • A strong communicator who can collaborate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders in a diverse, interdisciplinary and international environment.
  • Passionate about working at the intersection of Climate Science and Data Engineering (tell us about relevant projects you’ve worked on!).
  • Organised, detail-oriented, and motivated self-starter with strong analytical skills.
  • Proven ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with project stakeholders.
  • Good communication skills in English.

title: Associate Product Owner
description:
TL;DR

Full-time. Berlin-based. No remote option available for this role. You sit with the PM.

Join GlassDollar as an Associate Product Owner and own the space between a good idea and a shipped feature.
Someone has to decide what "done" means, write it down clearly enough that an engineer can start on Monday, and stay close enough to the build that the scope does not quietly grow on the way. That is the job. You own it end to end: specs, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and a backlog that keeps everyone honest about what is actually shipping. Nobody hands you a ticket queue you did not write yourself.

The problem you'll be solvingA corporation with 100,000 employees has thousands of expensive operational problems, and somewhere out there a startup has already solved most of them. Getting those two facts to meet is slow, political, and mostly attempted in spreadsheets that die in someone's downloads folder.
GlassDollar OS is the venture clienting platform that makes it repeatable: sourcing the startups, matching them to real problems, running the pilots, and rolling out what works across the whole organisation. Enterprise customers run real innovation budgets through it. What you scope this month decides what they can do next quarter.


What we´re looking for

You have personally written the tickets.
3+ years in a product company, where scoping and ticket-writing were actually your job rather than something you handed off.
You are technical enough to argue with engineers.
AI models, API contracts, estimates, sequencing. You push back with reasons, and you change your mind when the reasons coming back are better.
You can write.
A spec is a piece of writing. We will ask for a sample where the reasoning is visible, polish second.
You write specs worth acting on.
The valuable ones pull three threads together: where the product is going, what clients are actually telling us, and the knowledge already sitting in the team. You gather all three before you write, so what lands on the board is specific enough to build and pointed enough to matter.
You know what looks good.
You have a great sense of design and what feels good for users. We will ask you to build a prototype with AI and illustrate the specs visually.
You have worked somewhere small enough that there was nowhere to hide.
No layers between you and the consequences of a bad spec.
You want to be coached hard.
Direct feedback, weekly, on your actual work. You will scope alongside the product lead until you are doing it alone, and the goal is that this happens fast.
You are fluent with AI tooling, day to day.
We want to see the workflow, not hear it described.
You want the scope to grow.
The people who do best here end up owning areas outright: the major initiatives, the roadmap arguments, and the questions everyone else brings their doubts to. That is earned, and it is genuinely available.


What you`ll do

Your job: turn validated opportunities into work an engineer can start on Monday.

  • Turning opportunities into scoped, sequenced, estimable work: specs, acceptance criteria, edge cases, dependencies
  • Running the backlog: grooming, prioritisation input, keeping the board honest about what is in flight, blocked, or quietly drifting
  • Being the interface between customer signal (support threads, CS conversations, call notes) and the engineering queue
  • Coordinating releases and checking that what shipped matches what was scoped
  • Presenting product decisions to varied stakeholder groups, from engineers to enterprise clients

What you'll be scoping over your first year:
  • Deep integrations into our customers' organisations. Their systems, their data, their identity stack. This is the work that turns GlassDollar from a tool people visit into infrastructure they run on.
  • Public REST APIs and MCP servers, so our customers' engineers and their AI agents can build on top of us.
  • AI embedded across the product, inside the surfaces people already work in.
  • Workflow automation inside the platform, so the work that used to take six meetings and a shared spreadsheet runs itself.
You will need to understand each of these well enough to write the spec and defend it in the room.
This is a doing role rather than a people-management one. Mid-to-senior individual contributor.


Requirements

  • 3+ years in a product company, where you personally wrote the tickets
  • Technical enough to understand a data model, an API contract, and estimation
  • Demonstrable writing ability, be ready to share a spec, PRD or decision doc
Nice to have:
  • B2B enterprise SaaS background
  • Familiarity with venture clienting, corporate innovation, or startup-scouting workflows
  • Notion fluency

Don't check every box? Apply anyway. We care more about the questions you ask about a brief than the answer you land on.


How we hire

Straightforward. Respectful of your time. No mystery steps.

  1. Intro call: a quick chat to see if there's a match
  2. Interview with the PM, including a brief introduction to the work sample: a spec, PRD, or decision doc where your reasoning is visible, plus examples of problems you've framed
  3. Interview
  4. Offer: if it clicks, we don't wait around

title: Product Manager (parental leave cover)
description:
About Tandem

Tandem is the leading global language learning community, with over 35 million members from all around the world practicing languages together. The concept of learning from each other is not only core to the Tandem community, it is also at the heart of how we work every day at Tandem.


We are based in Berlin, profitable and growing, and backed by top European investors. We are highly international and driven by a shared passion for languages, technology, and culture. Together, we are on a mission to connect the world through languages, by building a product that helps people not just learn, but truly understand each other across cultures.


We are looking for a bright, data-driven, collaborative operator to help us improve the experience of our members. 


Your role will be to:

  • Run the experiment loop: hypothesis, spec, launch, readout, ship or kill. Keep a steady cadence of live tests.

  • Find the next bets from data, research, and member feedback - not from a backlog of random ideas.

  • Spec and land a small number of features with design and engineering; you are accountable for the outcome, not the ticket.

  • Share results in a way the rest of Tandem can act on.


You are the right fit for the role if you:

  • Have 3+ years of product management experience, including consumer mobile apps at scale.

  • Are analytical: you know the metrics that matter, can reason about experiments and statistical results, and are fluent in product analytics.

  • Have a proactive, independent way of working, with leadership and ownership you can point to - not only ideas, but things you shipped.

  • Are a clear communicator and a strong collaborator, with excellent written and spoken English.

  • Care about simple, intuitive user experiences and can work closely with design to get there.

  • Like hard problems and stay with them until they are solved.

  • Use AI in your own work to move faster, and are thoughtful about where it belongs in product operations.


The benefits


Passion for languages: 

We’re a team of 30 people speaking 20 languages fluently between us. For those wanting to improve their German (or Denglisch!), you can join one of our German classes on us.


Take a deep dive: 

As a Tandem team member, we’ll give you a budget for up to 6 “Deep Dive Days” per year. Pick a topic you’ve always wanted to explore for your professional development that has never made it out of your backlog. Then book a cabin in the woods or whatever matches your individual learning style.


Teams who train together, stay together: 

We offer Urban Sports Club gym memberships to boost our team’s physical and mental health. If you prefer, we can contribute to your monthly public transport ticket instead.


It takes a team to Tandem: 

Bonding with our teammates outside of our normal work routine is important to us. We organize regular team events: from day trips to monthly lunches, summer BBQs, and movie nights.


Balance matters: 

Life isn’t just about work. We know when to snooze Slack notifications, recharge our batteries, and take time out for our personal hobbies. As home office has become the new normal for some of us, it’s even more important to be able to switch off from work and relax.


Modern family: 

As part of our family-friendly company philosophy, we embrace flexible working hours, welcome families to our events, and love for our kids to visit the office and get a taste of life at Tandem.


Relocation without the stress: 

If you’re looking to relocate to Berlin, we’re ready to assist you with the infamous German bureaucracy. Many of us have been through it before, so we have plenty of tips to share. You’ll feel settled in no time.


Hybrid by design: 

We’re all about embracing a flexible, modern way of working. That’s why we focus on a hybrid approach—balancing time between our vibrant Berlin-Mitte office and the comfort of your home. It’s the best of both worlds, and we’ll support you in creating the perfect setup for this dynamic way of working.

Introduction

At a glance 

  • Location & work model: Berlin, hybrid
  • Tech stack: Kubernetes on our own servers, Harvester (KubeVirt), Argo CD/Flux, Prometheus/Grafana, Longhorn/Ceph
  • Team: A growing SRE team – you report to our CTPO for now and to the Team Lead SRE we're hiring next; two system administrators in Pforzheim run the physical hardware
  • Process: Intro call · take-home task (~2h) · 90-min tech interview with our developers · leadership conversation · meet the team
  • Languages: Fluent English required; German is a plus, not a must

Why this role is special 

Most SRE jobs today mean clicking around a managed cloud console. This one doesn't. We run our own hardware in Frankfurt and are building a modern private cloud platform on Kubernetes and Harvester – on-prem by default, with elastic burst into the public cloud and the option to go cloud-only later. You won't inherit a finished SRE practice: you'll help define it, side by side with our Berlin development teams – and you won't do it alone, a Team Lead SRE hire is coming next. 

SRE here is an enabling discipline: you build what our developers need to ship reliably, while two system administrators in Pforzheim run the physical hardware. And the impact is direct – our product discovery technology powers more than 2,000 European online shops (Intersport, SPAR, Douglas and more), handling billions of shopper queries a year. When product discovery is slow or down, our customers lose revenue in real time. 

Your first 90 days 

You get to know both products, join the on-call rotation with a buddy, and own your first reliability topic – SLOs for one product, alerting that actually helps at 3 a.m., or automating away a piece of toil. By day 90 you've shipped visible improvements and know where you want to take the platform next.


Your mission

  • Define and own SLOs, SLIs and error budgets; drive data-informed reliability decisions
  • Lead incident response end-to-end: fast detection, clear communication, blameless postmortems – and reduce whole classes of incidents structurally, not case by case
  • Eliminate toil through automation and GitOps; evolve our observability (metrics, logs, traces, alerting, runbooks) across two different stacks
  • Help build our custom Kubernetes operator (CRDs) that makes stateful search clusters declarative, self-healing and safely upgradable – and roll out the auto-scaling (HPA/VPA, KEDA, cluster auto scaler) today's architecture makes hard
  • Plan capacity, performance  and cost across on-premises and cloud – including the large-catalogue and peak-season loads our merchants care about – and use AI tools wherever they measurably speed up diagnosis and operations


Your profile

Must-haves: 

  • Kubernetes in production – built, not just used: you've set up and maintained clusters on your own servers (e.g. kubeadm, RKE2, k3s) and know cluster lifecycle and upgrades – managed-only experience isn't enough for this role
  • Lived SRE practice: SLOs, error budgets, incident management, on-call
  • Hands-on experience with GitOpsor comparable infrastructure/deployment automation – experience with Argo CD or Flux is a strong plus
  • Solid observability skills – metrics, logs, traces, alerting that people trust
  • A strong automation instinct – you'd rather fix a problem's cause than repeat its workaround
  • A collaborative, enabling mindset – you see SRE as a service to our developers: you ask what they need, discuss trade-offs openly, and don't fall in love with your own solution
Nice-to-haves (genuinely optional – we'll teach you the rest): 
  • Harvester, KubeVirt, vSphere/ESXi, OpenStack or similar virtualization/HCI platforms
  • Container storage (Longhorn, Ceph) and datacenter networking (load balancing, ingress, VLAN)
  • Auto-scaling (HPA, VPA, KEDA, cluster auto scaler) and capacity/cost planning
  • Experience building Kubernetes operators/CRDs
  • German language skills
Certifications (CKA, CKS) are welcome but no substitute for hands-on experience – in the tech interview we'll ask about what you've actually built and operated. 

You don't tick every box – or your title was never “SRE”? Apply anyway. If you've owned production systems, handled incidents and worked deeply with Kubernetes, we want to hear from you – production experience and engineering mindset matter more to us than titles or buzzwords.


THE JOY OF WORKING WITH US

  • Impact from day one: Your work directly influences the revenue of leading eCommerce brands across Europe.

Berlin, Munich, Pforzheim or Stockholm (all Hybrid)

Dabei arbeitest Du mit anspruchsvollen Mid-Market-, Enterprise- und Strategic Accounts – B2B- wie B2C-Unternehmen aus den unterschiedlichsten Branchen – und bewegst Dich souverän zwischen operativen eCommerce-Teams, technischen Ansprechpartnern und C-Level-Stakeholdern.

FactFinder ist eine der führenden Product-Discovery-Plattformen für den europäischen eCommerce. Über 2.000 Kunden wie Douglas und SPAR erzielen mit unserer KI-gestützten Produktsuche einen Gesamt-GMV von mehr als 160 Milliarden Euro pro Jahr.

Auf einen Blick

  • Kommerzielle Verantwortung: Upsell- und Expansion-Ziele sowie Churn-Prävention und Vermeidung von Downgrades – die kommerzielle Ownership liegt bei Dir als CSM

  • Team & Reporting: CS-Team mit klar definierten Senioritätsleveln, Reporting an die Director Customer Success

Über FactFinder
Seit über 20 Jahren entwickelt FactFinder KI- und Machine-Learning-Technologie für Produktsuche, Navigation, Personalisierung und Produktempfehlungen im Online-Handel. Mit unserer Product Discovery Experience (PDX), dem Investor Genui im Rücken und einem neuen Management-Team starten wir in die nächste Wachstumsphase. Rund 90 Kolleginnen und Kollegen arbeiten an unseren Standorten in Pforzheim, Berlin, München und Stockholm.


Your mission

  • Portfolio & Customer Value: Du verantwortest ca. 40–50 Mid-Market-, Enterprise- und Strategic Accounts, überwiegend im DACH-Markt – B2B- und B2C-Kunden aus den unterschiedlichsten Branchen, was die Rolle besonders abwechslungsreich macht. Gemeinsam mit Deinen Kunden definierst Du klare Ziele und Success-Pläne und machst den Mehrwert von FactFinder anhand relevanter KPIs messbar.
  • Retention & Churn-Prävention: Du erkennst anhand von Produktnutzung, Adoption und Kundenfeedback frühzeitig Risiken und leitest proaktiv Maßnahmen ein. Die kommerzielle Renewal-Verantwortung liegt bei Dir – mit starker Unterstützung durch unser Sales Operations Team. Da sich unsere Verträge in der Regel automatisch verlängern, liegt Dein Fokus auf Churn-Prävention und der Vermeidung von Downgrades.
  • Upsell & Expansion: Du verantwortest Expansion in Deinem Portfolio end-to-end – von der Identifikation der Opportunity bis zum kommerziellen Abschluss, aktuell punktuell noch mit Unterstützung durch Sales. So arbeitest Du im Team
Du übernimmst Deine Kunden ab Vertragsunterschrift von Sales und begleitest sie über den gesamten Customer Lifecycle. Im Alltag arbeitest Du am engsten mit unseren Business- und Technical-Consulting-Teams zusammen, die Dich beim Onboarding, bei Integrationen und bei komplexeren Fragestellungen unterstützen. Unser Service Desk übernimmt operative Tickets und Nutzungsfragen. So kannst Du Dich voll auf die strategische und kommerzielle Entwicklung Deiner Accounts konzentrieren.

description:

Adsquare's mission is centered on:

  • Passion: Solving complex challenges with exceptional people, technology, and data.

  • Niche: Specializing in Location Intelligence for Programmatic Advertisers.


Our work is guided by our core values, and we look for candidates who embody them:

  • No BS: Upholding honesty, transparency, and clear communication.

About the team

You'll join Adsquare's Data Products team, responsible for the pipelines and signals that power our Location Intelligence solutions. Working closely with our Lead PM for Data Products and a squad of data engineers, you'll help ingest, process, and scale the supplier and panel data that fuels our products. Your squad sits at the intersection of engineering, data governance, and downstream teams like Measurement and Activation, ensuring the signals we deliver are fast, reliable, and trustworthy.


Your Mission

As Product Owner for SDV Data Products (f/m/d), you'll own your squad's delivery, turning strategy into clear, testable backlog items while managing the technical scale of our core data pipelines. You'll be the primary technical counterpart to our data suppliers and panel partners, driving the operational reliability that keeps our signals fresh and trusted.


Your Profile

  • 3-5 years of experience as a Product Owner or technical PM, ideally in AdTech, MarTech, or another data-heavy ecosystem.

  • Strong at managing delivery and technical scale: sequencing complex backend work, mapping dependencies, and scoping against time, whether working with engineers, architects, or integration teams.

  • Operationally rigorous: comfortable thinking in SLIs, SLOs, freshness, match rate, and MTTR, not just features shipped, and skilled at running a tight, testable backlog.

  • Data-fluent, with required SQL proficiency: able to independently query internal data sources to investigate supplier data, panel quality, and pipeline KPIs, and bring quantified evidence into prioritisation.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity: able to make decisions with limited information and translate business intent clearly for engineering.

  • A privacy-aware product thinker who understands data governance and how evolving privacy frameworks affect upstream ingestion and pipeline logic.

  • A clear communicator across altitudes, able to translate strategy into specs and engineering reality into product trade-offs.

  • A true owner who drives outcomes without step-by-step direction and surfaces tensions upward rather than resolving them quietly.


What you will do

  • Own and maintain your squad's backlog, working closely with the Lead PM for Data Products to translate strategy into clear, testable user stories.

  • Lead the roadmap for modernising, scaling, and optimising our core data ingestion and processing pipelines to handle high-throughput workloads.

  • Manage internal dependencies — SLAs, schema contracts, and joint roadmap touchpoints — with downstream squads such as Measurement, Activation, and Data Products.

  • Coordinate releases of new schemas, ingestion endpoints, match logic changes, and signal product enhancements.

  • Act as the primary PO-level counterpart to data supplier and panel partner technical teams, co-owning ingestion specs and schema contracts.

  • Support the Lead PM on new supplier partnerships and panel expansion through feasibility input, integration scoping, and prototype delivery.

  • Define, own, and report on operational KPIs such as signal freshness, SLA adherence, panel coverage, schema validation pass rate, and match rate.

  • Establish SLIs, SLOs, and escalation paths in partnership with engineering, and own the operational visibility layer (dashboards, alerts) that surfaces data product health.


Nice to Have

  • Based in Berlin, or open to working from our Berlin office periodically.

  • Prior experience collaborating directly with identity vendors, panel providers, or purchase-data suppliers on schema and integration work.


Our Software Stack

On top of a competitive package…

title: Product Engineer (Backend/AI) @Briink
description:
What we do

At Briink, we’re building AI technology for the global sustainability economy. We work with the world’s largest climate organizations, including CDP and PRI, and multinational companies such as Bayer, Siemens, Commerzbank, E.ON, and Heidelberg Materials.

Our technology helps automate how sustainability data is collected, analyzed, verified, and acted on. Through our work with global climate organizations, what you build at Briink will directly impact the sustainability workflows of more than 30,000 companies, investors, and cities worldwide.

We’re a small team working at enormous scale. Your code won’t sit behind an internal tool or an experimental demo — it will help shape how some of the world’s largest organizations understand and act on their environmental impact. Based at Berlin’s AI Campus, with a second office in London, and backed by over €7 million in funding, we want to prove that some of the world’s most powerful technology can also be a powerful force for good.

Application requirement: Intro video
As part of your application, please submit a short intro video (max 2 minutes) answering:

  1. Who you are and what you have done/built that is relevant for this role. 
  2. Why you’re excited about owning and shipping AI-powered products at Briink. 
  3. Why Briink’s sustainability mission resonates with you.
Upload your video using this form (YouTube unlisted, Loom, or any other solution is fine). We do this to get a better sense of candidates before continuing the process. Any application without a video will not be considered ;)


Your role

As Briink’s Backend/AI Product Engineer, you’ll join a small, high-ownership product and engineering team building AI-powered products for sustainability professionals.

This is not a narrowly scoped backend role. You’ll take meaningful product problems from initial discovery and user conversations through technical design, implementation, and iteration to deploy them at scale across the ESG market. You’ll combine strong backend and AI/LLM engineering with product judgement and the initiative to work out what should be built - not just how to action a predefined ticket.

You will:

  • Own product features end to end, from understanding the user problem and defining the right approach through to delivery, measurement, and improvement.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
What's it all about?

The balance of power in the energy industry needs to change. The intermittency of renewable supply and the constant demands of the grid mean that we still rely on less efficient, more expensive and unsustainable fossil fuels to keep the lights on. At Gridfuse, our mission is to shift this balance through technology. To shift the balance of inputs, so that renewables become the world's main source of electricity.  

At Gridfuse, we develop the software that controls real renewable energy assets and turns them into a coordinated Virtual Power Plant (VPP) that can respond intelligently to energy markets and grid conditions.


Your impact

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will build the systems that connects our platform to these assets and turn energy-market and grid requirements into real-world actions. Your code will influence when batteries charge or discharge, how renewable assets respond, and how reliably these assets can participate in the electricity system. 

You will own and evolve core parts of the Control services, working closely with other software engineers and our renewable-energy experts.


The role

  • Design and build distributed control systems that coordinate fleets of batteries, wind turbines and solar plants 
  • Translate complex energy-market and grid requirements into reliable software behaviour 
  • Build the services responsible for communicating with physical assets and processing their telemetry, status and capabilities 
  • Design systems that continue to behave predictably when devices fail, networks are unreliable, messages arrive late or assets become temporarily unavailable
  • Build highly observable and resilient services that operate continuously in production
  • Take your services from architecture and implementation through deployment, monitoring and operation 
  • Work closely with energy-market specialists to understand the problem and turn it into pragmatic technical solutions 
  • Make architectural and technical decisions that balance reliability, scalability, simplicity and delivery speed 
  • Mentor other engineers and raise the technical bar across the team 


What we need from you

  • You are a self-starter who enjoys working in a fast-paced startup environment
  • You have several years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production backend systems
  • You have experience designing and architecting distributed systems
  • You have a “you build it, you run it” mindset and are familiar with Linux, Docker and Kubernetes
  • You have strong backend experience with Go or another modern programming language (We primarily use Go, but prior Go experience is not required)
  • Experience with asynchronous / event-driven systems. Experience with NATS, Kafka, RabbitMQ or MQTT is a plus
  • Solid understanding of SQL and NoSQL databases; experience with InfluxDB or Timescale is a plus
  • You communicate clearly and confidently in English


What we offer

  • Competitive hardware including a standing desk, 4K curved screen, and MacBook Pro  
  • City center office location including home office option  
  • EGYM Wellpass membership support 
  • Educational budget for every employee 
  • Team events, summer & winter parties
  • Real startup culture by having an impact in a small, motivated team   


Sounds good to you?

Please submit your complete application including your salary expectations and earliest starting date.   

After submitting an application our team will review this and get back to you within a couple of business days.

title: Working Student (all genders) – Robust Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction for Dynamic Scene
description:
Abstract

Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models can recover scene geometry directly from images or videos without costly scene-specific optimization. By combining large-scale pre-training, multi-view reasoning, and strong geometric priors, these models provide an efficient alternative to traditional reconstruction pipelines such as Structure-from-Motion, NeRF, and optimization-based 3D Gaussian Splatting.

Despite recent progress, current models remain sensitive to challenging real-world conditions. title: Senior Product Manager - Salesforce & Internal Enablement (all genders)
description:
Responsibilities

We are looking for an experienced, passionate, and hands-on Senior Product Manager to join our product team and empower Aroundhome’s core business operations for our next phase of growth.

Aroundhome is Germany's leading platform for home projects, connecting thousands of homeowners with the right local service partners. The Internal Enablement team owns the core CRM and operational infrastructure -primarily built on Salesforce- that powers our sales teams and customer care in the future. By transforming fragmented, legacy setups into a scalable, automated core, your work directly enables our business teams to drive growth and deliver a seamless experience to our partner network.

At Aroundhome, Product Managers play a pivotal role in shaping our platform’s success. We work in a domain-based model, where each cross-functional product team has full ownership over a clearly defined part of the platform. This structure fosters close collaboration and ensures that expertise for continuous product discovery and iterative improvement sits directly within each domain.

As a Senior Product Manager for Internal Enablement, you will translate our growth strategies into a clear future-state vision for our operational ecosystem. You will drive process automation, data consistency, and core tool integration, ensuring our platform can scale efficiently as we significantly expand our business.

  • As a Senior Product Manager, you define and execute a strategic product roadmap that translates our growth goals into a modern, future-proof Salesforce ecosystem.
  • You combine user research, process analysis, and quantitative data to identify root problems and systematically validate high-impact opportunities.
  • You challenge legacy workflows to design reusable capabilities, clean data flows, and clear technical boundaries between Salesforce and connected systems.
  • You make evidence-based decisions to prioritize your backlog, focusing relentlessly on business growth and operational scalability.
  • You partner closely with Salesforce Architects, Salesforce Administrators, Data and Engineers to manage the product lifecycle and release testable, incremental value quickly.
  • You align business stakeholders across Sales and Operations, actively guiding internal teams through training, change management and process adoption.
  • You track clear success metrics to measure operational efficiency gains, while exploring AI applications to continuously optimize workflows and user outcomes.


Skills

  • Proven track record as a Senior Product Manager driving large-scale CRM transformations, with deep hands-on expertise in the Salesforce ecosystem (certifications are a strong plus).
  • Expertise in continuous product discovery and translating high-level business goals into measurable, outcome-based metrics.
  • Strong understanding of system architecture, data synchronization, and API-based integrations between Salesforce and complex adjacent tools.
  • Exceptional communication and storytelling skills to align cross-functional teams and actively drive product adoption across all organizational levels.
  • Hands-on experience integrating AI tools into daily workflows (e.g., for research, technical discovery, or prototyping) to boost productivity and innovation.
  • Business fluency in both English and German is required to effectively collaborate with tech teams and drive change management with local operational staff. 


What we offer

Hybrid Work // Stay flexible: We embrace a hybrid working model that balances the autonomy of remote work with purposeful in-person collaboration. Ideally, you are based in Berlin or live within an easy commuting distance. While we offer flexibility, monthly presence in our office for team days, workshops, and meetings is required. Additionally, we offer you the possibility to work up to 30 days per year from selected EU countries.

Room to grow // Stay curious: In regular/annual feedback meetings, you design your own personal development path together with your team lead. In addition, we offer an annual training budget, free access to LinkedIn Learning, as well as great workshops to seek new input and specific training for your personal development.

Mental & physical health // Stay healthy & active: We care about your well-being and support your health with a discounted membership at Urban Sports Club. In addition, our cooperation partner "Fürstenberg Institute" is available to you and your family members with advice and support when it comes to mental health & coaching.

Taking responsibility // We #care: We care for our planet and the people who are living on it. To make our world a little bit better, our ESG Team (Environmental, Social & Governance) promotes our awareness of environmentally friendly behavior. In addition, we work with JobRad, offer a discounted BVG ticket, and actively support social projects in Berlin at our annual Social Day to give something back.

Teamspirit // Stay connected: What drives us is our sense of community. That's why we celebrate our Company Day once a month in our office at Potsdamer Platz, where everyone gets together in person. In addition to a comprehensive update of our C-Board, the main focus is on togetherness and the exchange of ideas over lunch and dinner together.

title: Project Engineering Manager - Core Spreads Manufacturing
description:
Location: Pratau, Germany

On-site

About the position

As a Project Engineering Manager – Core Spreads Manufacturing, you will be responsible for leading, coordinating, and delivering engineering and capital investment projects across the Core Spreads manufacturing network, with a primary focus on the Pratau and Katowice (by travelling) factories. The role is critical to strengthening manufacturing capability by implementing technically robust, safe, compliant, and cost-effective solutions that improve safety, quality, sustainability, reliability, capacity, and overall operational performance. The role covers the full project lifecycle, from initial business needs definition, feasibility assessment, concept development, budgeting, technical design, and supplier selection through installation, commissioning, qualification, operational handover, and post-implementation review. You will ensure that projects are delivered on time, within the approved budget, in accordance with company engineering standards, and in full compliance with safety, quality, food safety, GMP, and regulatory requirements.

You will:

  • Lead engineering and capital expenditure projects within the Core Spreads factories, ensuring clear scope, objectives, deliverables, responsibilities, timelines, and governance are established from project initiation.
  • Develop and manage project documentation, including business case inputs, user requirement specifications (URS), scope definitions, technical specifications, cost estimates, project schedules, risk registers, procurement packages, commissioning plans, and handover documentation.
  • Coordinate engineering design, equipment selection, vendor technical clarification, procurement support, installation planning, construction supervision, commissioning, qualification, and start-up activities.
  • Monitor project progress, costs, risks, and milestones, escalating issues where required and implementing corrective actions to ensure delivery against agreed targets.
  • Ensure effective project close-out, including completion of technical documentation, training, asset registration, maintenance requirements, lessons learned, and operational handover to site teams.
  • Perform engineering assessments, feasibility studies, option evaluations, and technical risk reviews to support investment decisions and project prioritisation.
  • Analyse process, packaging, utilities, and equipment performance data to identify opportunities to improve reliability, increase efficiency, reduce waste, improve yield, reduce energy consumption, and optimise costs.
  • Lead or support structured troubleshooting activities for recurring technical issues, applying root cause analysis and practical engineering problem-solving methodologies.
  • Drive value creation, continuous improvement, and operational excellence initiatives in close collaboration with Manufacturing, Maintenance, Quality, and T&I teams.
  • Support the standardisation of technical solutions, equipment specifications, and engineering ways of working across the Core Spreads manufacturing network.
  • Work closely with Manufacturing, Maintenance, Supply Chain, Quality, Safety, Procurement, Finance, and T&I stakeholders to ensure project objectives are aligned with business priorities and site operational needs.
  • Coordinate external suppliers, contractors, OEMs, and engineering service providers, ensuring clear technical communication, effective scope management, safety compliance, and high delivery performance.
  • Prepare clear project updates, decision papers, presentations, budget summaries, risk assessments, and steering committee materials for site and regional leadership teams.
  • Facilitate effective communication between sites, functions, and project teams to enable timely decision-making, resource availability, and smooth project execution during factory operations.
  • Ensure all project activities comply with company engineering standards, site safety rules, contractor management requirements, food safety standards, quality systems, GMP requirements, and all applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
  • Lead or support Management of Change (MoC) processes, ensuring that technical, operational, safety, quality, environmental, and financial impacts are appropriately assessed, documented, approved, and implemented.
  • Promote a strong safety and compliance culture by ensuring that appropriate risk assessments, method statements, permit-to-work procedures, contractor supervision, and safe start-up practices are in place.
  • Maintain accurate project records and support audit readiness through disciplined documentation, full traceability of decisions, and controlled handover of technical information.

So what does it take to be successful in this role?  

You have a bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, or a related field, along with at least five years of experience in project engineering, process engineering, maintenance engineering, or capital project delivery within the food industry or a similarly regulated manufacturing environment. You bring solid knowledge of food processing, packaging technologies, hygienic design principles, operational excellence, and change management practices. You have a strong understanding of engineering project delivery processes, industrial equipment, utilities, process systems, packaging lines, commissioning, and operational handover. You have demonstrated experience managing project budgets, schedules, suppliers, contractors, risks, and cross-functional stakeholders in a manufacturing environment, and are able to balance strategic project objectives with practical factory execution, ensuring technical solutions are reliable, maintainable, scalable, and aligned with long-term site and category manufacturing strategies. You are fluent in both English and German, with strong analytical and problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn. You are an effective communicator and collaborative team player, open to traveling for project execution, supplier visits, factory acceptance tests (FATs), and on-site activities. Additionally, you are proficient in MS Office and engineering software such as AutoCAD and SolidWorks.

mission

  • Own your performance: Du kennst deine Pipeline und KPIs, analysierst deine Ergebnisse und entwickelst deinen Sales Approach kontinuierlich weiter.

  • Sales Experience: Du bringst mindestens 2-3 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B Sales mit und hast bereits eigenständig Kunden gewonnen und Deals abgeschlossen. Erfahrung mit Small und Medium Accounts ist ein Plus.

  • Languages: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf C2-Niveau und sprichst fließend Englisch.

  • Mobility: Du hast einen gültigen Führerschein der Klasse B und bist bereit, regelmäßig innerhalb Deutschlands zu reisen (ca. 10–20 %).

What we offer

  • Earn & grow: Attraktives OTE-Modell aus Fixgehalt und ungedeckeltem Bonus – starke Performance soll sich für dich lohnen.

  • Learn fast: Strukturiertes Onboarding, Coaching, Shadowing und direktes Feedback helfen dir, deine Sales Skills schnell weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Own your numbers: Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Pipeline und KPIs und hast gleichzeitig den Freiraum, deinen eigenen Sales Style zu entwickeln.

  • Work smarter with AI: KI ist Teil deines täglichen Workflows – für effizienteren Research, bessere Insights und schnellere Vorbereitung.

  • Come as you are: Kein Dresscode – uns interessiert, was du bewegst, nicht was du trägst.

Innovation through diversity

Unabhängig von deinem Hintergrund, deiner Herkunft, deiner Geschlechtsidentität oder deinen individuellen Voraussetzungen ist es deine Persönlichkeit, die uns interessiert. title: Founding AI Engineer @handly - 20VC backed
description:
Germany has about a million trade businesses. They do more than €700 billion of work a year, and they run almost all of it by hand: quotes in the evening, invoices on the weekend, payments chased between jobs.

For decades, the software built for them was made for desk workers. Forms, menus, dropdowns, buttons. None of it was made for people who are always on the go and only care about the outcome.

AI changes that. For the first time, the admin of a trade business can be done for the owner instead of by them.

We are building a business-in-a-box for the trades.

Tradespeople want outcomes done for them, with as little interaction with software as possible. handly takes care of leads, quotes, measurements, invoicing and payments, so they can focus on their craft, and is accountable for the result.

We started with roofers in Germany. Other trades are next.

Delivering outcomes is a much harder problem than delivering software. That is the job of an AI-native services company. Most of our vision has not been built yet, and we are looking for top-tier talent in Berlin to help us bring it to life.

We are a small, close-knit team in Berlin-Mitte, backed by 20VC, Stride and Base10. We build, experiment and move fast, and we have found creative ways to use AI in every part of the company: product, ops, go-to-market and admin.

about the role

This role is for engineers who want to push what AI can do for a real business. As our founding AI engineer, you'll have high agency to hone your skills with AI and solve hard real-world problems that bring delightful experiences to our partners.

The biggest opportunity at handly: we run the entire administration of our partners, rather than one vertical of their needs. That gives AI the room to take on large, autonomous tasks end to end, and gives us room to get very creative with what AI can do as we capture more and more channels of communication.

You will own AI products end to end, make the core product and technical decisions, and turn messy, real-world workflows into AI that does the work for our partners.

We are a small team working on:

  • modernizing the user experience of an underserved industry
  • reimagining workflows that have not changed in decades, with AI
  • moving from AI workflows to high-autonomy agents
  • capturing data and context from calls, emails, photos, documents and voice

Tasks

AI already runs in production across handly: intelligence on every customer call, automatic payment matching, a daily briefing for every partner. Some of the bigger projects you will contribute to or lead:

  • Quote generation. Turn voice notes, photos and documents from customers and architects into a six-figure quote, priced intelligently from the partner's own catalog.
  • Measurements. Measure buildings from satellite imagery, drone footage and public building data, without a site visit.
  • Back office in natural language. An MCP layer over the whole product, so partners can manage their back office in a chat.
  • Email intelligence. Capture intelligence from email threads and attachments, automate communication with clients and suppliers, and aggressive anti-phishing and spam protection.
  • Self-improving pipelines. Use every correction, edit and rejection to improve the next output.
  • Evals. Build the evaluation sets and benchmarks that gate every AI feature before it ships.

Requirements

  • Have 4+ years of full-stack engineering experience (exceptions apply for exceptional engineers)
  • You have shipped AI features that real users depend on, and continiously evloved them.
  • Strong full-stack TypeScript comfortable across backend, web and mobile.
  • Experience building evals, benchmarks and self-improving loops that automate research on AI capabilities.
  • Creative about capturing data and context (transcripts, photos, documents, voice) to improve AI features.
  • Strong prompt engineering: structured outputs, tool use, agents, and good judgment about when an LLM is the wrong tool.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity. You lead your projects end to end and want to grow with the company.
  • Bonus: you have built your own fully functional AI side project. Send us your best one.

our tech stack

  • Full-stack TypeScript: Node.js, Express, Drizzle, Postgres
  • Web: React, Vite, React Query, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Zod
  • Mobile: React Native, Expo, EAS, React Query
  • AI: Vercel AI SDK, promptfoo, OpenAI and Anthropic models
  • Building: we use AI extensively to build, with zero friction adopting the best tools, and we built a custom software factory that takes care of small tasks
  • Infra: AWS, PostHog, Sentry

what may not make you a good fit

  • you prefer a remote or hybrid setup
  • you want to be told exactly what to do
  • you mostly care about the tech, not the outcome for the customer
  • you want to work 9-5

Benefits

  • competitive compensation package, €80–110k + 0.4–0.7% equity
  • unlimited access to frontier models and our always-on software factory
  • as much responsibility as you want, flat hierarchy
  • fast loops and direct feedback from the people who use what you build
  • minimal meetings: we have plannings and demo Fridays, No stand-ups, we like to maximize our focus time.
  • a tight, ambitious team that enjoys building hard things together from the comfort of our office.
  • regular team outings: dinners, padel, events and movie nights
  • a modern, light-filled office in Berlin-Mitte and great vibes ^^

Process

  1. Intro with Ohan (30m)
  2. Technical Background with Kais (45m)
  3. AI Product Engineering Challenge (3-4h)
  4. On-site with the product team and our CEO Basti - white-boarding, product taste & culture (half-day)

That’s it! We’ll reach out with an offer.

Start date: ASAP

Location: Berlin only, in-office
